review.notes: Eight distinct views reviewed against the existing orange wanderer; limited bare-character first release. Full action/loadout production remains unfinished.

model.identity: Existing orange hood and knee-length cloak with pale chalk stitches, cream face, small black eyes, dark gloves, cream leg wraps and dark shoes; no wood. Preserve hood outline, face proportions and outfit seams.
model.camera: Existing fixed game camera and upright sprite projection; world north is away from the viewer, south toward the viewer; no camera changes between clips.
model.handedness: Right hand gathers; left supports basket or lantern; both hands grip mining tools and protected crystal cargo. Never swap hands by mirroring.

idle.brief: A subtle complete breathing/rest loop with planted feet.

walk.brief: Full alternating walk cycle: contact, down, passing, up on both sides. Same phase landmarks in all eight directions.

gather.brief: Turn toward the actual nearby target, bend, reach, collect and recover; use only the registered physical loadout.

mine.brief: Two-handed wind-up, acceleration, contact, follow-through and recovery toward the actual rock target.

collect.brief: Reach toward the actual producer output and recover; retain body scale.

build.brief: Work toward the actual placed structure, with anticipation, physical contact and recovery.

cheer.brief: A short celebration that returns to the same grounded stance.

climbUp.brief: Physical hand-over-hand ascent through a generated passage; no teleport pose.

climbDown.brief: Physical descent through a generated passage and landing recovery.

variants.description: Earned tier-one mycelium basket and stone pick; fixed straps and grip; no invented boots or later tiers.
Earned sealed carrier with actual living-crystal cargo, securely held/protected.
Actual exposed living-crystal starter; careful two-handed handling, no invented protective carrier.
Earned hooded lantern in the left hand, same handle, shutter and light source.

inventoryCoverage: Initial production tranche, not exhaustive inventory coverage. Register every additional earned tier and valid loadout before treating that combination as complete.

legacy.status: existing shipped side-facing artwork; not accepted directional production coverage

firstRelease.scope: Bare character only: sixteen walk drawings and one static rest pose per direction. Tools, cargo, directional work and animated idle remain deferred.
